newsitem.title: USA: Immunex FLT3 shown to boost immune system.
newsitem.headline: Immunex FLT3 shown to boost immune system.

text.p: Immunex Corp said Tuesday that Phase 1 clinical trials had shown its Flt3 ligant compound boosted the number of dendritic cells, an immune system cell that plays a role in fighting cancer and infectious disease.

Trial results, presented at the 13th European Immunology Meeting in Amsterdam, showed an average 30-fold increase in functionally mature dendritic cells in the blood of people treated with Flt3 ligand. The increase was detected as early as five days after treatment began, and peaked at day nine, with dendritic cells composing an average 15 percent of total white blood cells, Immunex said.
The company said the results showed the compound could potentially be used as a vaccine adjuvant to treat cancer and infectious disease.

Immunex is already testing the Flt3 ligand compound as an agent for stem cell mobilization, a process in which stem cells are separated from the surrounding cells before a bone marrow transplant. It is also being tested as an anti-tumor compound in patients with prostate cancer and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma.
